title: Mutex fixes the race
description: With lock/unlock the counter is always 2.

input.code:
# The same counter++, protected by a mutex: the result is always 2.
shared counter = 0
mutex m

thread A
  LOCK m
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  UNLOCK m

thread B
  LOCK m
  LOAD r, counter
  ADD r, 1
  STORE counter, r
  UNLOCK m
